findings.summary: I2C clock exceeded the PM1 configuration
findings.detail: Observed 102040 Hz while PM1 register 0x09 allowed 100000 Hz. Use 100 kHz for initial communication and change both sides coherently. Real hardware may NACK; this observation does not inject a failure.

limits: PM1 wake/sleep delays, retry tolerance and analog power are not simulated. A successful simulation does not verify real hardware startup.
I2C rates are nominal controller settings. GPIO bit-banged clock rates and electrical signal quality are not measured.
CO5300 sleep/display and explicitly zero brightness affect visible output; physical brightness curves and uncertain reset defaults are not modeled.

limitations: Simulated time is not physical-device FPS.
BMI270 register model uses host-fed samples; physical mounting is unverified.
Physical double-click feel and tilt direction require user acceptance.
